div.div:
v4, draft 2026-11-11
Sources: DAQ VD Fiber Plant v3; "VD onDetector Rack View of Cabling" (TMS, stamped 16SEPT2026); "VD Cryostat 27U Detector Racks" naming drawing (20 N + 20 S racks); "DAQ Readout Network" PRR specification (EDMS 3463072, v1.0, 21 May 2026).
Open items
1. The readout network specification counts 42 VD DAPHNE (11 breakout ports, 5 uplinks, 2 servers); 40 are drawn, one per 27U rack. Where the other two sit is not known (the TMS sheet mentions an extra PDS membrane flange).
2. The TMS cabling sheet gives 1-4 10GbE LC links per DAPHNE. Drawn here: 4 patched, 1 active.
3. Ctrl ports per rack (DAPHNE 1, LCM 1, PoF 2) are read from the TMS sheet; the PoF count needs confirming.
4. DTS fanout rack on the cryostat roof: rack name and location, fanout hardware, number of fibers from the DTS master and its Ctrl network connection are not defined here.
5. The patching between the trunk patch panel and the readout switches (top-of-rack patch panels, MTP-12 into 4-way breakout transceivers, per EDMS 3463072) is not drawn in detail.
6. Two 10G Ctrl uplinks per 27U rack are assumed.
7. Purchase ownership assumed, not confirmed: racks (FDC I&I); patch cord from the 1G switch to the 27U patch panel (FDC I&I).
8. Follow-up: who purchases the 2xLC patch cord from the DAQ barracks patch panel to the Ctrl network switch (drawn as DAQ).
